planning_notes: No additional wiring or serial requirements were provided beyond D2 button and D13 LED, so only corresponding interfaces are registered.
The application uses SysML to implement: first press starts blinking, second press stops blinking and turns the LED fully off; all timing/thresholds belong in the model, not in device requests.

No active_high/pullup/inversion details were provided; the model assumes the button press corresponds to digital_input model value true (active_high). If the physical circuit is active-low with pullup, this must be corrected in the model pin semantics (not by altering catalog request here).

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Button press toggles LED working mode (press model true)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: LED output for flashing mode; off when not flashing

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 使用 D2 按钮切换 D13 LED 的工作模式：按一次开始闪烁，再按一次停止闪烁并熄灭。

requirements.text: 使用 D2 按钮切换 D13 LED 的工作模式：按一次开始闪烁，再按一次停止闪烁并熄灭。
